map.输入板厚、材料与焊接位置，推荐电流、电压、速度及热输入: Enter plate thickness, material and welding position to get recommended current, voltage, travel speed and heat input
map.💡 电流根据板厚与位置经验估算；电压 GMAW 取 U=14+0.05×I；热输: 💡 Current is estimated empirically from plate thickness and position; for GMAW voltage U = 14+0.05×I; heat input HI = U×I/v ÷1000 (kJ/mm).
map.推荐值为经验估算，实际应结合工艺评定（PQR）确定: The recommended values are empirical estimates; in practice they should be fixed by a procedure qualification (PQR)
map.立焊、仰焊位置需下调电流，薄板注意控制热输入: Vertical and overhead positions need lower current; on thin plate watch the heat input carefully
map.按板厚、材质与焊接位置推算电流、电压、速度等工艺参数，作为试焊起点。: Derive process parameters such as current, voltage and travel speed from plate thickness, material and welding position as a starting point for test welding.
map.估算热输入，判断参数组合是否会造成烧穿或热影响区性能劣化。: Estimate the heat input and judge whether the parameter combination would cause burn-through or degrade the heat-affected zone properties.
map.按位置修正电流（横、立、仰焊递减），给出不同位置的可操作参数。: Correct the current by position (decreasing from horizontal to vertical to overhead) to give operable parameters for each position.
map.基准电流 = 材质系数 × 板厚(mm) × 位置系数，材质系数：碳钢 40、不: Base current = material coefficient × plate thickness (mm) × position coefficient, where the material coefficient is 40 for carbon steel, 35 for stainless steel and 30 for aluminium; the position coefficient is 1.0 for flat welding PA, 0.85 for horizontal PC, 0.75 for vertical PF and 0.8 for overhead PE; the recommended current is the base value ±15%. Voltage: for manual arc welding U = 22 + 0.2×thickness, for other methods U = 14 + 0.05×base current. Travel speed: 2~4 mm/s for manual arc welding, 4~8 mm/s otherwise. Heat input HI (kJ/mm) = voltage × current ÷ travel speed (mm/s) ÷ 1000.
map.碳钢板厚 6 mm、平焊：基准电流 = 40×6×1.0 = 240 A，范围约: 6 mm carbon steel plate, flat welding: base current = 40×6×1.0 = 240 A, range about 204~276 A; manual arc welding voltage = 22+0.2×6 = 23.2 V; taking a speed of 3 mm/s, heat input = 23.2×240/3/1000 ≈ 1.86 kJ/mm (moderate). At the same thickness in the vertical position: current = 240×0.75 = 180 A, and you should work at the lower end for weld pool control.
map.立焊、仰焊为什么要减小电流？: Why reduce current for vertical and overhead welding?
map.非平焊位置熔池受重力影响易下淌，减小电流可降低熔池体积与流动性，便于成形；通常按: In positions other than flat welding the weld pool tends to run downward under gravity; reducing current shrinks the pool volume and its fluidity and makes the bead easier to form. A common rule is 75%~85% of the flat-welding current.
map.热输入多少算合适？: How much heat input is appropriate?
map.取决于材料与厚度：一般碳钢控制在 1~2.5 kJ/mm；薄板取小值防烧穿，厚板: It depends on material and thickness: for carbon steel, keep it within 1~2.5 kJ/mm; thin plate takes the lower value to prevent burn-through, while thick plate and hardenable steels need enough heat input to lower the cooling rate. The procedure qualification remains the authority.
map.焊接参数计算工具，输入板厚、材料（碳钢/不锈钢/铝合金）、焊接位置与方法，推荐焊: The welding parameter calculation tool takes plate thickness, material (carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminium alloy), welding position and method, then recommends a welding current range, arc voltage, travel speed, heat input and consumable diameter to support initial process parameter selection.
map.考虑材料与焊接位置修正: Correction for material and welding position
map.同时输出电流、电压、速度: Outputs current, voltage and speed together
